## Description

Load what day one needs (patients seen in last 24 months, future appointments, balances, active meds, allergies, problems, last results) in hours; CDC streams new legacy rows during a 1–2 week parallel run with fallback to the old system; older visits backfilled overnight in batches; scanned PDFs indexed first, OCR on open; legacy stays read-only for an agreed period.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Day-one load completes within the agreed window with counts matching the signed dry run.
- [ ] **AC2.** During the parallel run, changes in the legacy system appear in Medvya within the agreed latency, without duplicates.
- [ ] **AC3.** Every imported value carries an "Imported" badge with source system, original id and import date.
- [ ] **AC4.** Cut-over checklist allows staff to fall back at any time until sign-off.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
